import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook("/workspace/data.xlsx")
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Collect all data
headers = [cell for cell in next(ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=1, values_only=True))]
print("Headers:", headers[:12])

# Get unique values for key columns
efficacy_vals = set()
groups_vals = set()
ages = []

for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    seq, groups, efficacy, age = row[0], row[1], row[2], row[3]
    if seq is not None:
        efficacy_vals.add(efficacy)
        groups_vals.add(groups)
        if age is not None:
            ages.append(age)

print(f"\nEfficacy unique values: {efficacy_vals}")
print(f"Groups unique values: {groups_vals}")
print(f"Age range: {min(ages)} - {max(ages)}")
print(f"Number of patients: {len(ages)}")

# Count efficacy categories
from collections import Counter
efficacy_counts = Counter()
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    seq, groups, efficacy = row[0], row[1], row[2]
    if seq is not None:
        efficacy_counts[efficacy] += 1
print(f"Efficacy counts: {dict(efficacy_counts)}")

import bioblend.galaxy
import json

api_key = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

representation = {
    "class": "GalaxyUserTool",
    "id": "logistic-regression-age-v1",
    "name": "Logistic Regression Age",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "container": "quay.io/biocontainers/r-base:4.4.1",
    "shell_command": (
        "set -eu\n"
        "Rscript -e '\n"
        "data <- read.table(\"$(inputs.input.path)\", header=TRUE, sep=\"\\t\", stringsAsFactors=FALSE, na.strings=\"\");\n"
        "data <- data[!is.na(data$Age) & data$Efficacy != \"\", ];\n"
        "data$response <- ifelse(data$Efficacy == \"PR\", 1, 0);\n"
        "model <- glm(response ~ Age, data=data, family=binomial);\n"
        "coef_table <- coef(summary(model));\n"
        "write.table(data.frame(Variable=rownames(coef_table), coef_table, check.names=FALSE), file=\"coefficients.tsv\", sep=\"\\t\", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE);\n"
        "'\n"
    ),
    "inputs": [
        {
            "name": "input",
            "type": "data",
            "format": ["tabular"],
            "label": "Input tabular dataset"
        }
    ],
    "outputs": [
        {
            "name": "coefficients",
            "type": "data",
            "format": "tabular",
            "label": "Coefficient estimates",
            "from_work_dir": "coefficients.tsv"
        }
    ]
}

if hasattr(gi, "unprivileged_tools"):
    created = gi.unprivileged_tools.create_user_tool(representation)

else:

    print(f"Available attributes: {[a for a in dir(gi) if 'tool' in a.lower()]}")
